summary.key_theme: Quanta Services 受益於資料中心基礎設施建設需求強勁，長期績效表現優異，吸引機構投資人持續布局。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Data Center Push Keeps Valuation In Focus
bullish.reason: 公司積極投入資料中心電力基礎設施建設，符合當前 AI 產業發展趨勢，市場對其估值與成長潛力給予高度關注。

bullish.title: Quanta Services: A Strong Backlog And An Even Bigger Opportunity
bullish.reason: 公司在 2026 財年第二季實現 41% 的營收年增率，強勁的訂單積壓（Backlog）顯示未來營收成長動能明確。

bullish.title: Polen Focus Growth Portfolio Q3 2026 Portfolio Update
bullish.reason: 知名投資組合 Polen Focus Growth 在第三季將 Quanta Services 列為新進持股，顯示專業機構對其長期成長性的認可。

bullish.title: Here's How Much $100 Invested In Quanta Services 5 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
bullish.reason: 過去 5 年年化報酬率超越大盤 27.29%，展現公司長期穩健的獲利能力與市場競爭優勢。

bearish.title: Why Quanta Services (PWR) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
bearish.reason: 股價單日跌幅超過大盤，反映短期市場獲利了結壓力或技術性修正，需觀察後續支撐力道。

bearish.title: S&P 500 Gap-Down Stocks Fall in October 20, 2026 Session
bearish.reason: 被列入標普 500 指數跳空下跌名單，顯示短期股價動能轉弱，但屬於整體市場波動範疇。

neutral.title: If You Invested $100 In Quanta Services Stock 20 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
neutral.reason: 僅為歷史績效回顧，對當前股價影響有限，屬中性資訊。

neutral.title: Powerfleet Named AIoT Fleet Management Software Company of the Year 2026 by Transportation Outlook
neutral.reason: 該新聞提及的是 Powerfleet (代號 AIOT)，與 Quanta Services (代號 PWR) 無直接業務關聯，僅因代號重疊被誤植，對 PWR 股價無影響。
